question: Should OpenClaw accept `memorySearch.queryInstructionTemplate` as a public opt-in config/provider/SDK contract for model-family embedding query templates?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config and plugin/provider API surface, and current main has no established OpenAI query-template contract.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this unsponsored external PR now, and allow a maintainer to reopen or request a fresh PR if they want this API direction.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in API
options.body: A maintainer explicitly owns the new contract and asks for a refreshed PR with current-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Decline the new surface
options.body: Keep existing `inputType` and `queryInputType` controls as the supported OpenAI-compatible customization path for now.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this unsponsored external PR now, and allow a maintainer to reopen or request a fresh PR if they want this API direction.
